note: after an untrusted-certificate TLS load (amqps:// or MQTT ssl://) fails, the oracle's LOG_ENTRIES retrieval fails: Jackson cannot write the throwable's JSSE PKIX cause chain (ValidatorException, SunCertPathBuilderException). The answer is the generic 500 text and the log gets a LogEntrySerializer failure entry (the number of entries, the index of the one that failed, its type and correlation id). A TLS failure that is no PKIX one does not fail (see the plain-text broker steps).

steps.note: AMQP over TLS to this server's own port by IP: the client does not trust MockServer's CA; the load fails
LOG_ENTRIES: the oracle cannot write the log, Jackson failing on the throwable's JSSE PKIX cause chain: 500 text, the generic message
the text log after the amqps load: the serialization failure of LogEntry (its count, index, type and correlation id) and the retrieval's own unexpected exception

mask.reason: the load's body names the server's port, whose digit count differs between the oracle and replay
the failing entry's index: the server's TLS handshake entry (the client's alert) and the load's unexpected exception race for the last two places in the log
